title: onboard-orchidx-7b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Elena Kim
description: Onboard OrchidX-7B v1.0: add model metadata, performance profiles for common serving footprints, and wire up changelog/release-note automation. Motivation: OrchidX-7B is a new community model we've validated for production inference (better latency/quality tradeoff for mid-sized deployments). This PR adds model metadata (license, tokenizer, recommended context sizes), curated perf profiles for 1/2/4 GPU shapes, and a small automation that generates per-model release notes from perf test artifacts and commits. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata JSON and manifest - [x] Generate perf profiles (latency/cost matrices) for seq len 128/512/2048 - [x] Add example serving config and quantization recommendation - [x] Add changelog automation hook to registry CI - [x] Add unit tests for metadata schema validation - [x] Ensure docs/examples updated - [x] Get approvals and merge Notes on automation: the automation is intentionally non-destructive — it appends a generated entry to models/CHANGELOG.md and opens a draft release note when the model is first onboarded. The CI job runs perf tests in perf-canary, uploads summarized artifacts to the model-registry CI bucket, and the changelog script consumes those artifacts to fill latency/cost numbers. Backwards compatibility: metadata schema version bumped to v1.2 but is backward compatible with v1.1 — new optional fields included with sensible defaults. Related: ENG-4283 for perf verification, PM-121 for product acceptance.

notes_for_reviewers: Key things to validate: metadata schema changes (v1.2), reproducibility pins (tokenizer_sha/hf_snapshot), and that perf numbers in perf-profiles match the perf-canary artifacts. The changelog automation is conservative: it only appends when a new model/version is detected and is enabled behind a CI flag 'ENABLE_MODEL_CHANGELOG'.
